policy: Official picks use Hubáček gates: decorrelated model beats the de-vigged market by >= 2 pp, honest EV >= 2% (calibrated pre-decorrelation probability), and a per-bet-type confidence bar (20 pp moneyline, 10 pp baseball/soccer, 5 pp spread cover). Live thresholds live in web/hubacek_picks.py; this file only stores per-league bet-type overrides and backtest metadata.
